cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made soup. Being rejected by the choir doesn't mean you skip dinner. Small spoonfuls first, please; it's hot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm making sure you're settled. Bread with the butter side up, please. I'll fetch you another piece.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sit down. I can hear you crying whenever you go into the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Put your bowl closer so I can reach it. I'll butter the bread here. Please tear it for me first; I can't see where the knife is going.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1/A3 direct meal care while distress leaks; A5 tries to continue serving but the bowl-and-bread sequence is muddled.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 notices no eating; B4 hears kitchen crying, causing A5 to stay, but moving the soup bowl does not enable buttering bread.

relationship.evidence: B4 wants A present rather than isolated and crying.

heightening.evidence: A5 exposes tears interfering with knife work while still offering care.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 combines too many physical tasks instead of one clear adapted comfort action.
